content: Timers surviving app kill: the canonical pattern is to never persist elapsed ticks - persist only started_at epoch ms, derive elapsed = Date.now() - started_at on every render, and drive UI with a local setInterval that recomputes from the timestamp (not by accumulating). No background execution, no headless JS, no alarms needed. On completion, write event + delete timer_state in a single transaction. This works across backgrounding, app kill, and device reboot, and is what tracker apps (breastfeeding timers) do. Matches BabyLog docs/05 timer_state.started_at design exactly.
